12: class InputSearchBase(ABC):
13:     @staticmethod
14:     def apply_weights(net, weight_sample):
15:         with torch.no_grad():
16:             for name, param in net.named_parameters():
17:                 param.copy_(weight_sample[name])
18: 
19:     def __init__(
20:         self, net: SymbolNet, start_inputs=None, start_weights=None, use_cuda=False
21:     ):
22:         self.net = net
23:         self.start_inputs = start_inputs
24:         self.start_weights = start_weights
25:         self.use_cuda = use_cuda
26: 
27:     @abstractmethod
28:     def search_one(self, start_inp, timeout_ms: int = None) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
29:         pass
30: 
31:     def search(
32:         self, max_time_ms: int = None, max_sample: int = 1
33:     ) -> Tuple[int, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
34:         n_try = 0
35:         sat_inputs = None
36:         start_time = time.time()
37: 
38:         while (
39:             max_time_ms is None or time.time() - start_time < max_time_ms / 1000
40:         ) and n_try < max_sample:
41:             if self.start_weights is not None and n_try < len(self.start_weights):
42:                 self.apply_weights(self.net, self.start_weights[n_try])
43:             else:
44:                 weight_sample = {}
45:                 for name, param in self.net.named_parameters():
46:                     weight_sample[name] = random_tensor(
47:                         param.shape, dtype=param.dtype, use_cuda=self.use_cuda
48:                     )
49:                 self.apply_weights(self.net, weight_sample)
50: 
51:             if self.start_inputs is not None and n_try < len(self.start_inputs):
52:                 cur_input = self.start_inputs[n_try]
53:             else:
54:                 cur_input = self.net.get_random_inps(use_cuda=self.use_cuda)
55: 
56:             res = self.search_one(cur_input, max_time_ms)
57:             n_try += 1
58:             if res is not None:
59:                 sat_inputs = res
60:                 break
61: 
62:         return n_try, sat_inputs
63:

65: class SamplingSearch(InputSearchBase):
66:     # Think about how people trivially generate inputs.
67:     def search_one(self, start_inp, timeout_ms: int = None) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
68:         with torch.no_grad():
69:             self.net.check_intermediate_numeric = True
70:             _ = self.net(**start_inp)

145: def broadcast_shapes(
146:     *shapes: List[Union[z3.ExprRef, int]]
147: ) -> List[Union[z3.ExprRef, int]]:
148:     """this function does not check the validity of broadcast. Please always pair it with broadcast_cons"""
149:     SanityCheck.gt(len(shapes), 0)
150:     if len(shapes) == 1:
151:         return shapes[0]
152:     max_dim = max(map(lambda x: len(x), shapes))
153:     max_shape = [None] * (max_dim)
154:     for j in range(max_dim):
155:         i = -j - 1
156:         args_dim_sz = [_prepend_to(x, max_dim)[i] for x in shapes]
157:         if any(isinstance(s, z3.ExprRef) for s in args_dim_sz):
158:             max_shape[i] = z3.simplify(z3_bcast(*args_dim_sz))
159:         else:
160:             max_shape[i] = max(*args_dim_sz)
161:     return max_shape

172:             for x in shapes:

176:                     )
177:             axis_cons = z3.simplify(z3.And(*axis_cons))
178:             cons.append(axis_cons)
179:         else:
180:             args_dim_sz = [_prepend_to(x, max_dim)[i] for x in shapes]

180:             args_dim_sz = [_prepend_to(x, max_dim)[i] for x in shapes]
181:             valid = all(

183:             )

190: def broadcast_cons_binary(*shapes: List[Union[z3.ExprRef, int]]) -> List[z3.BoolRef]:
191:     SanityCheck.eq(len(shapes), 2)
192:     tgt_shape = broadcast_shapes(*shapes)
193:     cons = []
194:     max_dim = len(tgt_shape)
195:     lhs, rhs = shapes
196:     lhs = _prepend_to(lhs, max_dim)
197:     rhs = _prepend_to(rhs, max_dim)
198:     for j in range(max_dim):
199:         i = -j - 1
200:         if isinstance(tgt_shape[i], z3.ExprRef):
201:             cons.append(
202:                 z3.simplify(
203:                     z3.Or(
204:                         nnsmith_eq(lhs[i], 1),
205:                         nnsmith_eq(rhs[i], 1),
206:                         nnsmith_eq(lhs[i], rhs[i]),
207:                     )
208:                 )
209:             )
210:         else:
211:             valid = (
212:                 nnsmith_eq(lhs[i], 1)
213:                 or nnsmith_eq(rhs[i], 1)
214:                 or nnsmith_eq(lhs[i], rhs[i])
215:             )

222: def broadcast_to_cons(*shapes: List[Union[z3.ExprRef, int]]) -> List[z3.BoolRef]:
223:     """Unidirectional broadcast. Last input is the target shape.
224: 
225:     Examples of valid unidirectional broadcast:
226:     [1, 2, 3] -> [0, 1, 2, 3]
227:     [1] -> [3]
228: 
229:     Examples of invalid unidirectional broadcast:
230:     [0, 1, 2, 3] -> [1, 2, 3]
231:     [3] -> [1]
232: 
233:     Logic: for each dim: src_dim == tgt_dim or src_dim == 1
234:     """
235:     srcs, tgt = shapes[:-1], shapes[-1]
236:     cons = []
237:     max_dim = len(tgt)
238:     for src in srcs:
239:         ConstraintCheck.true(len(src) <= max_dim)
240:         src = _prepend_to(src, max_dim)
241:         for i in range(max_dim):
242:             if isinstance(tgt[i], z3.ExprRef) or isinstance(src[i], z3.ExprRef):
243:                 cons.append(
244:                     z3.simplify(
245:                         z3.Or(nnsmith_eq(src[i], 1), nnsmith_eq(src[i], tgt[i]))
246:                     )
247:                 )
248:             else:
249:                 valid = nnsmith_eq(src[i], 1) or nnsmith_eq(src[i], tgt[i])
250:                 # TODO(JK): enable this after fixing issue #2
251:                 # assert valid, "Invalid broadcast shapes lhs={}, rhs={}".format(lhs, rhs)
252:                 cons.append(z3.BoolVal(valid))
253:     return cons

257: class AbsOpBase(ABC):
258:     # number of parameters; None means it's fixed that can be inferred through `signature`.
259:     num_var_param = None
260:     # whether this op is broadcastable or not
261:     bcastable = False
262:     # input dtypes: enumerates all possible input dtype combinations. Size of the list is the number of combinations.
263:     # Each element is a tuple of allowed input dtypes. NOTE: len(list) can >= the # of inputs, for handling ops with arbitrary arity.
264:     # For example, [(DType.float32, DType.float32), (DType.float64, DType.float64), (DType.int32, DType.int32)] means that
265:     # this op can accept one of float32xfloat32, float64xfloat64, and int32xint32 as input dtypes.
266:     in_dtypes: List[Tuple[DType, ...]] = None  # Overwrite me!
267:     out_dtypes: List[Tuple[DType, ...]] = None
268:     # whether to disable the op during graph generation
269:     _skip = False
270: 
271:     dialect = None
272: 
273:     def __init__(self):
274:         assert self.dialect, "Set dialect with `mark_dialect` or `mark_realize`"
275: 
276:         # `[3, 3]` this means this op requires 2 inputs. Where the 1st one has 2 dimensions, and the 2nd one has 3 dimensions.
277:         # `-1` means arbitrary dimantions; NOTE: but should be concretized during execution.
278:         # All symbols of correponding operator must be the constructor's parameters.
279:         # [ <inp0>(support_dim0, support_dim1, ...), <inp1>(...), ... ]
280:         self.inp_ranks = []
281:         # NOTE: the concrete values of out_ranks are not useful. Just make sure the length is correct.
282:         # NOTE: the output shape of input dimensions should be concretized during the execution.
283:         self.out_ranks = []
284:         # Require the input dimension sizes to be equivalent.
285:         self.same_inp_dims = False
286:         # NOTE: the input of operator constructors are all Union[int, z3.ExprRef].
287:         self.extra_attrs = {}
288: 
289:     @classmethod
290:     def get_num_var_param(cls):
291:         if cls.num_var_param is None:
292:             return len(signature(cls.__init__).parameters) - 1
293:         return random.choice(cls.num_var_param)
294: 
295:     @abstractmethod  # Overload me!
296:     # Exception means rejection.
297:     def type_transfer(self, input_shapes: List[AbsTensor]) -> List[AbsTensor]:
298:         raise NotImplementedError
299: 
300:     @check_shape_fn  # Public API.
301:     def checked_type_transfer(self, input_shapes: List[AbsTensor]) -> List[AbsTensor]:
302:         self.last_outs = self.type_transfer(input_shapes)
303:         return self.last_outs
304: 
305:     # Overload me!
306:     # Extra constraints for the input tensors.
307:     # Exception means rejection.
308:     def requires(self, input_shapes: List[AbsTensor]) -> List[Union[z3.ExprRef, bool]]:
309:         return []
310: 
311:     @abstractmethod
312:     def deduct_inp_ranks_and_dtype(
313:         self, out_abs_tensor: List[AbsTensor]
314:     ) -> List[Tuple[int, DType]]:
315:         raise NotImplementedError
316: 
317:     @check_require_fn  # Public API.
318:     def checked_requires(self, input_shapes):
319:         return self.requires(input_shapes)
320: 
321:     def n_floats(self, input_shapes: List[AbsTensor]) -> z3.ExprRef:
322:         return reduce(nnsmith_add, [i.nelement() for i in self.last_outs])
323: 
324:     def flops(self, input_shapes):
325:         return 0
326: 
327:     def __repr__(self) -> str:
328:         return self.__class__.__name__
329: 
330:     @classmethod
331:     def __str__(cls) -> str:
332:         return cls.name()
333: 
334:     @classmethod
335:     def name(cls) -> str:
336:         if hasattr(cls, "dialect"):
337:             return cls.dialect + "." + cls.__name__.split(".")[-1]
338:         return cls.__name__.split(".")[-1]

341: def concretize_op(op: AbsOpBase, model: Optional[z3.ModelRef]) -> AbsOpBase:
342:     if isinstance(op, Constant) or isinstance(op, Input):
343:         ret_op = deepcopy(op)
344:         values = []
345: 
346:         for idx, s in enumerate(op.abs_tensor.shape):
347:             if isinstance(s, z3.ExprRef):
348:                 ret_op.abs_tensor.shape[idx] = model.eval(s).as_long()
349: 
350:         return ret_op
351: 
352:     # Non-inp / const types.
353:     construct_param_dict = signature(op.__init__).parameters
354:     values = []
355:     symbolic_idx = []
356: 
357:     if op.num_var_param is not None:
358:         # input is a variable list.
359:         key = list(construct_param_dict.keys())[0]

360:         values = list(getattr(op, key))
361:         symbolic_idx = [
362:             i for i in range(len(values)) if isinstance(values[i], z3.ExprRef)
363:         ]
364:     else:
365:         for idx, key in enumerate(construct_param_dict):
366:             param = getattr(op, key)
367:             values.append(param)
368:             if isinstance(param, z3.ExprRef):
369:                 symbolic_idx.append(idx)
370: 
371:     for idx in symbolic_idx:
372:         values[idx] = model.eval(values[idx]).as_long()
373: 
374:     concrete_op = type(op)(*values)
375:     concrete_op.inp_ranks = op.inp_ranks
376:     concrete_op.out_ranks = op.out_ranks
377:     concrete_op.same_inp_dims = op.same_inp_dims
378:     concrete_op.extra_attrs = op.extra_attrs
379: 
380:     return concrete_op

1030:         # collect guidance
1031:         graph = self.abstract_graph
1032:         shuffled_nids = list(graph.nodes)
1033:         random.shuffle(shuffled_nids)
1034:         all_cons = []
1035:         for node_id in shuffled_nids:

1043:                 cons = self.gen_ph_cons(op)
1044:             if len(cons) == 0 or random.uniform(0, 1) > self.constrain_prob:
1045:                 continue

1047: 
1048:         # apply all guidance at once and back off if failed

1052:         while self.check_sat(*cur_cons) != z3.sat:

1057:         if MGEN_LOG.getEffectiveLevel() <= logging.DEBUG:

396:     def backward_insert_node(
397:         self, node, input_nodes: List[Union[int, Placeholder]], occupied_idx
398:     ):
399:         # self.placeholder idx -> nx graph node idx
400:         occ_holder_idx_nx = [self.placeholders[i] for i in occupied_idx]
401: 
402:         itensor_idx = []
403:         for input_node in input_nodes:
404:             # Insert Placeholder in `input_nodes`
405:             if isinstance(input_node, Placeholder):
406:                 nid = self.get_new_node_id()
407:                 shape_idx = len(self.tensor_dataflow)
408:                 self.tensor_dataflow.append(
409:                     TensorCtx(op_id=nid, type=input_node.out_shape, output_idx=0)
410:                 )
411:                 self.dim2shape_idx.setdefault(input_node.out_shape.ndims, []).append(
412:                     shape_idx
413:                 )
414:                 self.abstract_graph.add_node(
415:                     nid,
416:                     op=input_node,
417:                     nin=0,
418:                     nout=1,
419:                     itensor_idx=[],
420:                     otensor_idx=[shape_idx],
421:                     label=textwrap.fill(
422:                         f"#{nid} ~ {input_node}",
423:                         width=__TEXTWRAP_WIDTH__,
424:                     ),
425:                 )
426:                 itensor_idx.append(shape_idx)
427:                 self.placeholders.append(nid)
428:             else:
429:                 itensor_idx.append(input_node)
430: 
431:         # Insert node
432:         to_occ_alive_shape_idx = [
433:             self.id2nxnode(nx_nid)["otensor_idx"][0] for nx_nid in occ_holder_idx_nx
434:         ]
435:         op_nx_idx = self.forward_insert_node(
436:             node,
437:             itensor_idx=itensor_idx,
438:             oshapes=[
439:                 self.tensor_dataflow[as_idx][1] for as_idx in to_occ_alive_shape_idx
440:             ],
441:             force_otensor_idx=to_occ_alive_shape_idx,
442:         )
443: 
444:         # Insert edges and remove placeholders
445:         for i, nx_idx in enumerate(occ_holder_idx_nx):
446:             for (src, dst, key) in list(self.abstract_graph.edges(nx_idx, keys=True)):
447:                 # multi-graph
448:                 edge_info = copy.deepcopy(
449:                     self.abstract_graph.get_edge_data(src, dst, key=key)
450:                 )
451:                 old_edge_idx = edge_info["shape_idx"]
452:                 # recall alive shape:
453:                 # 1. op nx idx
454:                 # 2. shape var
455:                 # 3. out operand idx
456: 
457:                 _, svar, _ = self.tensor_dataflow[old_edge_idx]
458:                 out_operand_idx = i
459:                 in_operand_idx = edge_info["operand_idx"][1]

460: 
461:                 # add cur node -> dst
462:                 self.abstract_graph.add_edge(
463:                     op_nx_idx,
464:                     dst,
465:                     key=str(uuid.uuid1()),
466:                     shape_idx=edge_info["shape_idx"],  # reuse old alive shape
467:                     operand_idx=(out_operand_idx, in_operand_idx),
468:                     label=f"{out_operand_idx}→{in_operand_idx} {svar.dtype.short()}!{svar.shape}",
469:                 )
470:                 self.tensor_dataflow[old_edge_idx] = TensorCtx(
471:                     op_nx_idx, svar, out_operand_idx
472:                 )
473: 
474:                 self.abstract_graph.remove_edge(src, dst, key=key)
475: 
476:             # if the PH to occupy has no consumers, we simply reassign its alive shape.
477:             # NOTE: we assume the first node is a placeholder.
478:             if self.init_ph_alive:  # update alive_shape[0]
479:                 self.tensor_dataflow[0] = TensorCtx(
480:                     op_nx_idx, self.tensor_dataflow[0][1], 0
481:                 )
482:                 self.init_ph_alive = False
483: 
484:             # remove placeholders
485:             self.abstract_graph.remove_node(nx_idx)
486:             # self.reusable_placeholder_nx_indices.append(nx_idx)
487:             self.placeholders.remove(nx_idx)

603:         self,
604:         node_t,

606:         dtype_combs_spec: List[Tuple[DType, ...]],
607:         candidate_shapes: List[AbsTensor],

611:         Args:
612:             ndim_list (List[Set]): duable dims for each input.

614:         Returns:
615:             List[int]: indices to applicable shape variables.
616:         """
617: 
618:         abs_tensor_candidates = []
619:         if MGEN_LOG.getEffectiveLevel() <= logging.DEBUG:
620:             MGEN_LOG.debug(f"Input data types candidates: {dtype_combs_spec}")
621: 
622:         all_can_dtypes = []
623:         for i, ndims in enumerate(ndim_list):
624:             all_can_dtypes.extend(
625:                 [
626:                     candidate_shapes[i].dtype
627:                     for i in self.filter_shapes(
628:                         ndims=ndims, dtype=None, candidate_shapes=candidate_shapes
629:                     )
630:                 ]
631:             )
632:         # only use dtypes currently available after ndim filtering
633:         dtype_combs = [
634:             comb for comb in dtype_combs_spec if all(i in all_can_dtypes for i in comb)
635:         ]
636:         if len(dtype_combs) == 0:
637:             raise RequiredDimNotFound(
638:                 "Op %s: Cannot find a shape variable with dim_spec %s and dtype combinations %s."
639:                 % (node_t, ndim_list, dtype_combs_spec)

640:             )

645:             )
646:             abs_tensor_candidates.append(self.pick_shape(node_t, candidates))
647: 
648:         return abs_tensor_candidates

652:     def insert_init_ph_node(self, ph: Placeholder) -> Placeholder:
653:         self.forward_insert_node(ph, [], oshapes=[ph.out_shape])
654: 
655:         for c in ph.out_shape.gt_zero():
656:             self.solver.add(c)
657: 
658:         if self.limnf:
659:             if NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "0":
660:                 self.n_floats = nnsmith_add(self.n_floats, ph.out_shape.nelement())
661:             elif NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "1":
662:                 self.n_floats_cons.append(
663:                     nnsmith_le(ph.out_shape.nelement(), self.limit_float // 16)
664:                 )
665:         return ph
666: 
667:     # subclasses may override this
668:     def extra_constraints(self, node: AbsOpBase, input_shapes: List[AbsTensor]):
669:         return []

671:     def try_forward_insert_at(self, node: AbsOpBase, itensor_idx: List[int]) -> bool:
672:         input_shapes = [self.tensor_dataflow[idx][1] for idx in itensor_idx]
673:         constraints = node.checked_requires(input_shapes)
674: 
675:         if SMT_LOG.getEffectiveLevel() <= logging.DEBUG:
676:             SMT_LOG.debug(f"---> Trying to solve: {node} ~ {constraints}")
677: 
678:         # make a copy
679:         output_shapes = node.checked_type_transfer(input_shapes)
680:         if self.limnf:
681:             if NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "0":
682:                 tmp_n_floats = nnsmith_add(self.n_floats, node.n_floats(input_shapes))
683:             elif NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "1":
684:                 tmp_n_floats_cons = self.n_floats_cons + [
685:                     nnsmith_le(node.n_floats(input_shapes), self.limit_float // 16)
686:                 ]
687: 
688:         for shape in output_shapes:
689:             for c in shape.gt_zero():
690:                 constraints.append(c)
691: 
692:         # constraints.extend(self.extra_constraints(node, input_shapes))
693:         if self.limnf:
694:             if NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "0":
695:                 check_res = self.check_sat(
696:                     *constraints, nnsmith_le(tmp_n_floats, self.limit_float)
697:                 )
698:             elif NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "1":
699:                 check_res = self.check_sat(*constraints, *tmp_n_floats_cons)
700:         else:
701:             check_res = self.check_sat(*constraints)
702: 
703:         if check_res != z3.sat:
704:             return False
705: 
706:         for c in constraints:
707:             self.solver.add(c)
708:         if self.limnf:
709:             if NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "0":
710:                 self.n_floats = tmp_n_floats
711:             elif NNSMITH_LIMNF_V == "1":
712:                 self.n_floats_cons = tmp_n_floats_cons
713: 
714:         if MGEN_LOG.getEffectiveLevel() <= logging.DEBUG:
715:             MGEN_LOG.debug(f">> Forward insert: {node}")
716:             MGEN_LOG.debug(f"\tinputs:  {input_shapes}")
717:             MGEN_LOG.debug(f"\toutputs: {output_shapes}")
718: 
719:         self.forward_insert_node(node, itensor_idx, output_shapes)
720:         return True

723:         self, node: AbsOpBase, occ_holder_indices: List[int]
724:     ) -> bool:

726:             MGEN_LOG.debug(
727:                 f"---> Trying to occupy placeholder: {occ_holder_indices} for node {node}"
728:             )

730:         #                   - a new placeholder (fallback)
731:         #                   - an existing alive shape

733:         to_occupy = [

819:         ub = self.sample()

824:         return lb, ub

41: # Probablistically, sampling at positive domain is beneficial.
42: def random_tensor(shape, dtype, margin=4, base=5, use_cuda=False):
43:     # center: -margin ~ 0 ~ +margin
44:     dev = torch.device("cuda" if use_cuda else "cpu")
45:     if base == "center":
46:         base = -margin / 2
47:     else:
48:         assert isinstance(base, int) or isinstance(base, float)
49: 
50:     fp_tensor = base + (torch.rand(shape, device=dev) - 0.5) * margin
51: 
52:     if dtype.is_floating_point:
53:         return fp_tensor.to(dtype)
54:     else:
55:         return torch.round(fp_tensor).to(dtype)

58: class SymbolNet(nn.Module):
59:     def __init__(
60:         self,
61:         schedule: Schedule,
62:         record_intermediate=False,
63:         use_gradient=False,
64:         megabyte_lim=__MB_LIM__,
65:         print_grad=0,
66:     ):
67:         super(SymbolNet, self).__init__()
68:         self.megabyte_lim = megabyte_lim
69:         self.print_grad = print_grad
70:         # <TorchFunc, <keys -> inputs>, <keys -> outputs>, original op>
71:         self.instructions = []
72:         self.n_vulnerable_op = 0
73: 
74:         self.proxy_enabled_ = False
75: 
76:         # keep track of layers and weights so that the tracing can work properly
77:         self.mlist = nn.ModuleList()
78:         # whether or not to register intermediate tensors as output tensors. Useful (at least) for checking nan
79:         self.record_intermediate = record_intermediate
80: 
81:         self.n_floats, self.flops = 0, 0
82: 
83:         self.schedule = schedule
84: 
85:         for op, inputs, outputs in self.schedule.instructions:
86:             if not isinstance(op, Input):
87:                 torch_fn = forward_fn(op)
88:                 SanityCheck.true(torch_fn is not None, f"Bad implementation for {op}")
89:                 if isinstance(torch_fn, nn.Module):
90:                     self.mlist.append(torch_fn)
91:                 self.instructions.append((torch_fn, inputs, outputs, None))
92: 
93:                 if loss_fn.dispatch(type(op)):
94:                     self.n_vulnerable_op += 1
95: 
96:                 self.instructions.append(
97:                     (torch_fn, inputs, outputs, op)
98:                 )  # TODO Colin op is redundant?
99: 
100:         # the order follows `input_keys`
101:         self.input_map = {
102:             f"i{i}": self.schedule.key2type[k]
103:             for i, k in enumerate(self.schedule.input_keys)
104:         }
105:         self.output_map = {
106:             f"o{i}": self.schedule.key2type[k]
107:             for i, k in enumerate(self.schedule.leaf_keys)
108:         }
109:         self.iname2key = {f"i{i}": k for i, k in enumerate(self.schedule.input_keys)}
110:         self.oname2key = {f"o{i}": k for i, k in enumerate(self.schedule.leaf_keys)}
111: 
112:         self.first_run = True
113: 
114:         self.use_gradient = use_gradient
115:         if use_gradient:
116:             self.enable_training()
117:         self.check_intermediate_numeric = False
118:         self.invalid_found_last = None
119: 
120:     @property
121:     def input_like(self):
122:         return self.input_map
123: 
124:     @property
125:     def output_like(self):
126:         return self.output_map
127: 
128:     @property
129:     def proxy_enabled(self):
130:         return self.proxy_enabled_
131: 
132:     def enable_proxy_grad(self):
133:         for i, inst in enumerate(self.instructions):
134:             _, inputs, outputs, op = inst
135:             if proxy_fn.dispatch(type(op)):  # has proxy
136:                 self.instructions[i] = (proxy_fn(op), inputs, outputs, op)
137: 
138:         self.proxy_enabled_ = True
139: 
140:     def disable_proxy_grad(self):
141:         for i, inst in enumerate(self.instructions):
142:             _, inputs, outputs, op = inst
143:             if proxy_fn.dispatch(type(op)):  # has proxy
144:                 self.instructions[i] = (forward_fn(op), inputs, outputs, op)
145: 
146:         self.proxy_enabled_ = False
147: 
148:     def get_params(self):
149:         return sum([i["params"] for i in self.optimizer.param_groups], [])
150: 
151:     def _zero_grad(self):
152:         for p in self.get_params():
153:             p.grad = None
154: 
155:     def backward(self):
156:         if self.loss is not None:
157:             self._zero_grad()
158:             params = self.get_params()
159:             loss_name, l = self.loss
160:             l.backward()
161: 
162:             with torch.no_grad():
163:                 for param in self.parameters():
164:                     param.copy_(
165:                         torch.where(
166:                             param.isnan().logical_or(param.isinf()),
167:                             random_tensor(
168:                                 shape=param.shape, dtype=param.dtype.torch()
169:                             ).to(param.device),
170:                             param,
171:                         )
172:                     )
173: 
174:             if self.print_grad >= 2:
175:                 for name, i in self.interm_grad:
176:                     msg = (
177:                         f"{i.grad.min()} ~ {i.grad.max()} ~ {i.grad.mean()}"
178:                         if i.grad is not None
179:                         else "None"
180:                     )

2: Class members of AbsOpBase like in_dtypes, out_dtypes, etc. are just the superset
3: of the valid domain that do not take the upcoming inference engine's operator
4: availability into account. For example, older versions of TVM may not support trilu
5: and TensorRT does not accept a 2D Pool whose kernel is larger than 300. Therefore,
6: to narrow those specifications, we look at the following methods:
7: - Identifier: Model and BackendFactory
8: 1. Single-operator specification testing: Iterate over possible operator instances
9:    of available `data types` (and `ranks`), and try to kick out failing ones (loggings
10:    will be kept to see if it is just an unimplemented feature or a bug).
11: 2. Constraint extension: for a BackendFactory, it can add more constraints to an operator.
12:    This is useful for cases like TensorRT where the kernel size is limited to < 300.
13: - HOWTO:
14: 1. Single-operator potential data types (and ranks) are serializable as a JSON file.
15: 2. Constraint extensions are defined as Python codes. That said, we can just overload the
16:    operator specifactions in backend (see nnsmith/abstract/extension).

53: def _make_single_op_schedules(
54:     op: AbsOpBase, ishapes, available_idtypes
55: ):  # List<Tup<DTypeComb,DTypeComb,Sched>>
56:     """Given a concretized op, return a schedule for it."""
57:     schedule_list = []
58:     input_keys = list(range(len(ishapes)))
59:     for idtype_group in available_idtypes:
60:         key2type = {}
61:         instr = []
62:         inputs = []
63: 
64:         for idx, (ishape, idtype) in enumerate(zip(ishapes, idtype_group)):
65:             inp = Input(dim=len(ishape))
66:             inp.abs_tensor = AbsTensor(shape=ishape, dtype=idtype)
67:             instr.append(
68:                 Instruction(
69:                     op=inp,
70:                     inputs=[],
71:                     outputs=[idx],
72:                 )
73:             )
74:             key2type[input_keys[idx]] = inp.abs_tensor
75:             inputs.append(inp.abs_tensor)
76: 
77:         this_op = deepcopy(op)
78:         outputs = this_op.checked_type_transfer(inputs)
79:         this_op.input_like = inputs
80:         this_op.output_like = outputs
81: 
82:         leaf_keys = list(range(len(inputs), len(inputs) + len(outputs)))
83: 
84:         instr.append(
85:             Instruction(
86:                 op=this_op,
87:                 inputs=input_keys,
88:                 outputs=leaf_keys,
89:             )
90:         )
91: 
92:         for key, aten in zip(leaf_keys, outputs):
93:             key2type[key] = aten
94: 
95:         schedule_list.append(
96:             (
97:                 idtype_group,
98:                 tuple([out.dtype for out in outputs]),
99:                 Schedule(instr, input_keys, leaf_keys, key2type),
100:             )
101:         )
102:     return schedule_list

40: def torch2onnx(
41:     model: SymbolNet,
42:     exportable: Union[str, BytesIO],
43:     verbose=False,
44:     dummy_inputs=None,
45:     do_constant_folding=False,
46: ) -> None:
47:     """Convert PyTorch model to ONNX format."""
48:     proxy_enabled = model.proxy_enabled
49:     if proxy_enabled:
50:         model.disable_proxy_grad()
51: 
52:     # Dummy inputs
53:     if dummy_inputs is None:
54:         dummy_inputs = [
55:             torch.ones(size=svar.shape).uniform_(1, 2).to(dtype=svar.dtype.torch())
56:             for _, svar in model.input_like.items()
57:         ]
58: 
59:     input_names = list(model.input_like.keys())
60: 
61:     with torch.no_grad():
62:         with warnings.catch_warnings():
63:             warnings.simplefilter(
64:                 "default" if verbose else "ignore", category=torch.jit.TracerWarning
65:             )
66:             warnings.simplefilter(
67:                 "default" if verbose else "ignore", category=UserWarning, append=True
68:             )
69:             model.eval()
70:             torch.onnx.export(
71:                 model,
72:                 tuple(dummy_inputs),
73:                 exportable,
74:                 input_names=input_names,
75:                 output_names=list(model.output_like.keys()),
76:                 verbose=verbose,
77:                 do_constant_folding=do_constant_folding,

343:         ret_op = deepcopy(op)

354:     values = []
355:     symbolic_idx = []
356: 
357:     if op.num_var_param is not None:
358:         # input is a variable list.
359:         key = list(construct_param_dict.keys())[0]
360:         values = list(getattr(op, key))
361:         symbolic_idx = [
362:             i for i in range(len(values)) if isinstance(values[i], z3.ExprRef)
363:         ]
364:     else:
365:         for idx, key in enumerate(construct_param_dict):
366:             param = getattr(op, key)
367:             values.append(param)
368:             if isinstance(param, z3.ExprRef):
369:                 symbolic_idx.append(idx)
370: 
371:     for idx in symbolic_idx:
372:         values[idx] = model.eval(values[idx]).as_long()
373: 
374:     concrete_op = type(op)(*values)
375:     concrete_op.inp_ranks = op.inp_ranks
376:     concrete_op.out_ranks = op.out_ranks
377:     concrete_op.same_inp_dims = op.same_inp_dims
